name: Barcode
description: Shows a Code 128 barcode for an ID you supply -- a parkrun athlete ID, a membership number, a transit pass. Holds up to six, cycled on the watch. The IDs come from your phone; the watch only draws them.

configFields.label: Code 1 ID
configFields.description: The number printed under your barcode, copied exactly. Case matters. This is the code the watch shows first.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 1 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls this code, so you know which is which when you cycle through them. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 2 ID
configFields.description: A second barcode to carry -- a family member's parkrun ID, a membership number. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 2 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the second code. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 3 ID
configFields.description: A third barcode to carry. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 3 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the third code. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 4 ID
configFields.description: A fourth barcode to carry. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 4 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the fourth code. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 5 ID
configFields.description: A fifth barcode to carry. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 5 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the fifth code. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 6 ID
configFields.description: A sixth barcode to carry. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 6 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the sixth code. Optional.
